**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $950 000–$1 050 000  

> *Sources:* Zillow Home Value Index (ZVI), California Association of Realtors, and recent U.S. Census data. The median figure is widely reported as the most reliable indicator of typical home prices, while the mean is higher because a few very expensive properties pull the average up.
